```{r}
library(class)
library(caret)
library(dplyr)


#Load the feature set

features <- read.csv("D:/Coding - R/TPAB Music recs/scripts/data/processed/tpab_features_full.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
print(head(features, 3))

#Prepare feature matrix (exclude non-numeric columns)
feature_columns <- c("duration_ms", "popularity", "speechiness", "danceability", 
                     "tempo", "sentiment_mean", "sentiment_volatility", 
                     "sentiment_range", "theme_justice", "theme_self", 
                     "theme_spirituality", "theme_money")

feature_matrix <- features[, feature_columns]

feature_matrix[is.na(feature_matrix)] <- 0
#scaling features
scaler <- preProcess(feature_matrix, method = c("center", "scale"))
feature_scaled <- predict(scaler, feature_matrix)


find_similar_songs <- function(target_song_name, feature_data, 
                                song_names, k = 5) {
  # Find the target song index
  target_idx <- which(song_names == target_song_name)
  
  if (length(target_idx) == 0) {
    stop("Song not found in dataset: ", target_song_name)
  }
  
 
  train_data <- feature_data[-target_idx, ]
  train_names <- song_names[-target_idx]
  

  test_point <- feature_data[target_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  
  #KNN
  knn_result <- knn(train = train_data, test = test_point, 
                    cl = train_names, k = k)
  
  # Get distances for ranking
  distances <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(test_point, train_data)))[1, -1]
  
  # Create results dataframe
  results <- data.frame(
    original_song = target_song_name,
    recommended_song = train_names,
    similarity_rank = rank(distances),
    distance = distances,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    arrange(similarity_rank) %>%
    head(k)
  
  return(results)
}

#recommender
cat(paste(features$track_name, collapse = "\n"), "\n")

# Example; Find songs similar to "Alright"
alright_similar <- find_similar_songs(
  target_song_name = "Alright", 
  feature_data = feature_scaled,
  song_names = features$track_name,
  k = 5
)
print(alright_similar)

# Example 2: Find songs similar to "King Kunta"
kunta_similar <- find_similar_songs(
  target_song_name = "King Kunta", 
  feature_data = feature_scaled,
  song_names = features$track_name,
  k = 5
)
print(kunta_similar)

#  Album-wide recommendations (find most central songs)
# Calculate centroid of all TPAB songs
centroid <- colMeans(feature_scaled)

# Find songs closest to the centroid (most representative)
centroid_distances <- apply(feature_scaled, 1, function(x) {
  sqrt(sum((x - centroid)^2))
})

album_recommendations <- data.frame(
  track_name = features$track_name,
  distance_to_centroid = centroid_distances,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  arrange(distance_to_centroid)


print(head(album_recommendations, 5))
#prepare the album_recommendations to match the single-song results format
album_recomm_formatted <- album_recommendations %>%
  rename(recommended_song = track_name,
         distance = distance_to_centroid) %>%
  mutate(original_song = "TPAB_Centroid",
         similarity_rank = rank(distance),
         query_type = "album_centroid") %>%
  select(query_type, original_song, recommended_song, similarity_rank, distance)

#combine results
output_recommendations <- rbind(
  cbind(query_type = "single_song", alright_similar),
  cbind(query_type = "single_song", kunta_similar),
  album_recomm_formatted
)

if (!dir.exists("outputs")) {
  dir.create("outputs")
}

write.csv(output_recommendations, 
          "outputs/recommendations.csv", 
          row.names = FALSE)

```
